visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Combine the link states
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The link colour is written in two rules, one for normal links and one for visited links, with the same value. Merge them. The colour must stay.
visualizerParams.initialCode: Home

solution.explanation: A plain a selector covers every state of a link, so two rules with the same value are not needed. Add :hover or :visited only for the states that look different.
